goals.knowledge_statement: Scientific inquiry includes observing, asking a question, guessing a possible answer, testing the guess and analysing the results.
Curiosity sparks questions about how and why things happen.
An observation is information gathered directly through the senses or instruments; an inference is a conclusion based on observations and prior knowledge.
